title: Good transport links still add most value to house prices in key UK cities
key_point: Station within 500m vs 1,500m adds £42,700 (8.0%) in London vs ~4.6-4.9% Manchester/Glasgow; 80%+ Londoners value station proximity.

title: Estate agents at odds over 'overvaluing' to win instructions
key_point: 95% of agents see unrealistic rival valuations; 89% lost instructions to higher valuations; sellers advised to judge % of asking achieved.

title: Realistic pricing sees most active July since 2020, says Rightmove
key_point: A third of homes needed price cuts; unreduced homes sold in ~32 days vs ~99 days for reduced ones.

title: House price growth stalls as flat prices fall for 15th month in a row
key_point: UK flats -1.3% y/y vs houses +1.3%; a third of London flats are relisted; only 3 in 10 London flats sell within three months.

title: New-build buyers favour commuter counties over London
key_point: New-build sell-through Essex 27.6%, Herts 23.7% vs London 8.8%; buyers want space, green space, value while keeping commute.

title: New tool gives agents early insight into sellers' price expectations
key_point: AVM first, then seller flags unmeasured features (views, station proximity, gardens, extensions); agent decides adjustments.

title: Cock-up or conspiracy?
key_point: Overvaluation blamed for ~half of UK listings not selling within three years; honest error vs deliberate overpricing for sole agency.

title: Buyer enquiries rebound as well-priced homes continue to sell
key_point: Well-priced homes sell as fast as last year; London selling time +6 days; Harrow +65% to 54 days.

title: What's next for the housing market in 2025? Home buyer behaviour and user trends unveiled
key_point: 'Freehold' top search keyword two years running; 80% view floorplans before photos; 'needs modernisation' up 134 places.

title: Most parents willing to pay premium to live in top catchment areas
key_point: 73% of 2,000 parents would pay extra for top catchments; average 15% premium; would move 31 miles.

title: Rightmove upgrades AI tools to improve conversational property search
key_point: Conversational search adds free-text constraints (solar, transport, green space, commute time) to location/price/bedroom filters.

title: Estate agents expect AI to transform how buyers find homes
key_point: Most buyers still use traditional portal filters; 22% of agents hear AI mentioned; 84% expect AI search to dominate.

title: Renters face fiercest competition of 2026 as London demand jumps
key_point: 24 renters per new London listing in August 2026; average £571/week, Central London £632/week.

title: Renters now spending almost a third of income on rent as demand shifts
key_point: London average rent £2,418/month, 76% above UK; renters choose on affordability, connectivity and lifestyle.

title: Renters squeezed as asking rents outstrip budgets
key_point: 37.8% of flatsharers spend over half of income on rent; room rents exceed budgets in about half of 35 cities.

title: The new viewing question: how hot does this property get?
key_point: Buyers now ask about overheating, ventilation, shading; AC differentiates at top end but adds little value alone.

title: First-time buyer demand slips as just 1.8% of homes deemed suitable
key_point: Only 1.8% of London listings suit first-time buyers; Liverpool sells 51% of suitable stock.

title: Prime London property market suffers worst August in 18 years
key_point: PCL transactions -19% y/y, achieved prices -7%; half of available stock has had price reductions.

title: Prime London house prices rise for first time in four years as rents accelerate
key_point: PCL +0.3% q/q, -2% y/y; buyers 'sensing value'; POL 8.9 tenants per new rental listing.

title: London house prices could fall by £100,000 under Cleverly's mayoral plans
key_point: 420,500 left London for UK areas and 235,000 arrived from abroad (year to mid-2025); costs push young professionals outward.

title: The candour premium: Britain's rudest estate agent proves honesty pays
key_point: Agent trust 32% (Ipsos 2025); only 51% of movers trust their agent; candid defect disclosure builds credibility.

title: No news has been good news for the prime London market
key_point: PCL -22% since 2015 peak; £10m+ spend +14% to £2.4bn; demand driven by macro calm and mortgage rates.

title: Prime London rents rise as tenants feel the pre-Budget squeeze
key_point: POL rents +3% y/y; 8.9 tenants per new POL listing, 5.6 in PCL; landlords price in Renters' Rights Act risk.

title: Signs of a turn in the UK housing market?
key_point: RICS: buyer enquiries -19, agreed sales -17, new appraisals -17 net balance; rental stock ~25% below pre-pandemic.

title: Quality transport links rise up list of homebuyers' priorities
key_point: Broadband 82%, garden 76%, parks/finish/transport 74%; transport rose from 14th to joint 3rd since 2021.

title: Report reveals major shift in what triggers buyers' offers
key_point: 3,700 buyers: updated kitchen/bathroom 76%, garden 55%, cleanliness 49% trigger offers; move-in-ready preferred.

title: Mortgage rates aren't only factor deterring demand, research reveals
key_point: Moving costs (75%), sale certainty (34%), simpler process (30%) outrank lower mortgage rates (28%).

title: London 'remains attractive' for international buyers
key_point: 1,000 in NY/Singapore/Dubai/HK/Paris: 64% would relocate; London 2-bed ~23% cheaper than NY, ~60% below Singapore.

title: London's great again! US buyers defy Trump tariff chaos
key_point: US enquiries +20% y/y; 47% seek 1-2 beds, 32% 3-4 beds; Westminster and Camden top London targets.

title: Local knowledge – how property market data wins business
key_point: Agents value via comparables by type and attributes, sold-vs-asking trackers and postcode velocity, not area averages.

title: Hometrack launches arm offering valuation data for estate agencies
key_point: Agent AVM data uses comparables with photos/floorplans, Zoopla listings, 200m data points, lender survey data.

title: London buyers wait the longest to complete property sales
key_point: UK average 108 days to complete; Islington 150 days, Tower Hamlets 62; chains, searches, legal delays.

title: Tenants expect to stay renting despite desire to buy
key_point: Average tenancy 4.7 years; 44% expect to rent permanently; nearly half struggled to find suitable property.

title: Rightmove: Sea view asking prices up 27% since 2019
key_point: Sea-view homes +27% since 2019 vs 22% nationally; West Mersea premium ~51%; flood/insurance caveats.
